verses.en: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.pt: Tu, porém, fala o que convém à sã doutrina;
verses.en_web: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
verses.en_bbe: But let your words be in agreement with true and right teaching:

verses.en: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.pt: Aos velhos, que sejam sóbrios, respeitáveis, prudentes, sãos na fé, no amor e na paciência.
verses.en_web: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance:
verses.en_bbe: That old men are to be simple in their tastes, serious, wise, true in faith, in love, and of a quiet mind.

verses.en: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.pt: Às velhas, da mesma maneira, tenham bons costumes, como convém a santas; não caluniadoras, não viciadas em muito vinho, mas sim instrutoras daquilo que é bom;
verses.en_web: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;
verses.en_bbe: That old women are to be self-respecting in behaviour, not saying evil of others, not given to taking much wine, teachers of that which is good,

verses.en: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.pt: Para ensinarem às moças a serem prudentes, a amarem a seus maridos, a amarem a seus filhos;
verses.en_web: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.en_bbe: Training the younger women to have love for their husbands and children,

verses.en: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
verses.pt: A serem moderadas, puras, boas donas de casa, sujeitas a seus próprios maridos, para que a palavra de Deus não seja blasfemada.
verses.en_web: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
verses.en_bbe: To be wise in mind, clean in heart, kind; working in their houses, living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.

verses.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.pt: Exorta semelhantemente aos rapazes, que sejam moderados.
verses.en_web: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded;
verses.en_bbe: To the young men give orders to be wise and serious-minded:

verses.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.pt: Em tudo mostra a ti mesmo como exemplo de boas obras; na doutrina, mostra incorrupção, dignidade, sinceridade;
verses.en_web: in all things showing yourself an example of good works; in your teaching showing integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
verses.en_bbe: In all things see that you are an example of good works; holy in your teaching, serious in behaviour,

verses.en: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.pt: Uma palavra sã e irrepreensível, para que qualquer opositor se envergonhe, nada tendo de mal para dizer contra vós.
verses.en_web: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned; that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
verses.en_bbe: Saying true and right words, against which no protest may be made, so that he who is not on our side may be put to shame, unable to say any evil of us.

verses.en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
verses.pt: Que os servos sejam sujeitos a seus próprios senhores, sendo agradáveis em tudo, e não falando contra eles.
verses.en_web: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters, and to be well-pleasing in all things; not contradicting;
verses.en_bbe: Servants are to be under the authority of their masters, pleasing them in all things, without argument;

verses.en: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.pt: Não lhes furtando, mas sim mostrando toda a boa lealdade; para que em tudo adornem a doutrina de Deus nosso Salvador.
verses.en_web: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
verses.en_bbe: Not taking what is not theirs, but giving clear signs of their good faith, in all things doing credit to the teaching of God our Saviour.

verses.en: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.pt: Porque a graça salvadora de Deus se manifestou a todos os homens.
verses.en_web: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
verses.en_bbe: For the grace of God has come, giving salvation to all men,

verses.en: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.pt: Ensinando-nos que, ao renunciarmos à irreverência e aos maus desejos mundanos, vivamos neste tempo presente de maneira sóbria, justa e devota.
verses.en_web: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
verses.en_bbe: Training us so that, turning away from evil and the desires of this world, we may be living wisely and uprightly in the knowledge of God in this present life;

verses.en: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verses.pt: Aguardando a bem-aventurada esperança e o aparecimento da glória do grande Deus e nosso Salvador Jesus Cristo;
verses.en_web: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ;
verses.en_bbe: Looking for the glad hope, the revelation of the glory of our great God and Saviour Jesus Christ;

verses.en: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.pt: O qual deu a si mesmo por nós, para nos libertar de toda injustiça, e para purificar para si mesmo um povo particular, zeloso de boas obras.
verses.en_web: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
verses.en_bbe: Who gave himself for us, so that he might make us free from all wrongdoing, and make for himself a people clean in heart and on fire with good works.

verses.en: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.pt: Fala estas coisas, exorta, e repreende com toda autoridade. Ninguém te despreze.
verses.en_web: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise you.
verses.en_bbe: On all these points give teaching and help, and make clear what is right with all authority. Let all men give you honour.
